_note: S444 / D648 duty map, machine part: every recurring staff duty that has a queryable state in finance.db, each with ONE read-only SELECT returning one row (n = how many are due now, since = when the oldest became due). Read on every read of the owner's Needs-you list by amir_day.needs_you_lines (through the sanjeevni_approvals hook; read-only connection, SELECT/WITH only): an ORPHAN duty (door null -- nothing on the person's own home shows it) with n > 0 for allowed_days or more raises its owner_line, unless 'coded' names code that already raises the owner's line. A duty WITH a door raises nothing here unless it carries "raise": true (none does yet -- the owner's call). 'shared': a login that works another's queue (the staff-eye walk renders both homes). The staff-eye walk of every kit uses tile / door / door_marker. Rule: every kit that adds, moves or removes a staff duty updates this file and claude_code_briefs/DUTY_MAP.md together. S446 (02-Oct-2026): the doors of findings 1-4 and 9 added (Amir's card: the count by stage, the Sunday, arrived goods; Darpan's Kal ka hisaab: Amir's claims; Shavez's Vendor payments: an earlier month's baaki); the count vouchers' marker is the card's 'Marg sudhar'. S452 (02-Oct-2026): amir.rate_entry added (the board's '(b) Rate daalo' now has a door on his card, every step: 'N item ka rate Marg mein daalna hai -- kholiye'); amir.count_vouchers' Stage C is 12 a visit, more on request ('Aur voucher kholiye'). S454 (03-Oct-2026, part 1): the reception screen's one-task home -- reception.medicine_orders (Order karna hai: Darpan's sheet, or on order.source=system the day's proposals), reception.order_arrival (Maal aaya?: an order with no bill scan tied), reception.bill_scan (Bill scan karna hai: counted months only), reception.scan_questions (Photo dekh kar bataiye: counted months); darpan.order_sheet added (Kal ka hisaab's 'Order sheet' card; due only when the newest sheet was refused); shavez.supplier_messages counts the payment kinds only. S454 (03-Oct-2026, part 2): manoj.returns_ok reads the owner's own returns rule (returns.act_from; setting returns.pending_ok kept by amir_day when Needs-you is built); reception.bill_scan's owner line only after purchase.scan_wait_days (scan_register); amir.scan_files added -- never due: Amir is asked nothing new; amir.arrival_bill_entry due only after arrival.bill_grace_days, as its door. S482 (05-Oct-2026, D675 b): shavez.bill_chain_gap added -- a gap in Marg's bill numbers (mi_bill_chain, rewritten whenever a sale report or an EMPTY day lands) shows as one red line per gap on Aaj ki reports, naming the numbers and the days to re-export; the tile's own English line carries it to the owner (coded), and it leaves by itself when the re-export closes the gap. S485 (05-Oct-2026, D677): darpan.order_review added -- on order.source = darpan the system's order list opens on the second tab of Kal ka hisaab ('आज का ऑर्डर') from order.darpan_list_time; due while a proposal of today is still open (not yet Pakka); a proposal exists only on a supplier's order day, so no Sunday is ever due. darpan.order_sheet stays: the Marg sheet is the fallback road. S488 (06-Oct-2026, F-753/F-754 kit; no D-number): manoj.salt_list and manoj.item_lists added -- the owner's own Marg exports (the salt-wise list weekly; the category-wise list and the item list monthly) are his duties; their limits are setting rows (owner.salt_list_days 8, owner.item_lists_days 35, the same rows reports_tile's Marg card reads). They are the map's first duties with no door: the work is done in Marg and no page of ours does it -- the owner is told by amir_day's orphan-duty lines and by his console; the staff-eye walk exempts exactly these two ids from the door check. S494 (07-Oct-2026, D686): amir.marg_jobs added -- the owner's one-time Marg jobs for Amir (an item's category, a vendor's bill to scan for its bank details, a payment entry: table amir_job) are lines on his Marg sudhar card under 'Ek baar ke kaam', each gone when proved or tapped; the owner's lines are coded (amir_day._s494_owner_lines; the 'not done' line after amir.job_wait_days, 10). S524 (11-Oct-2026, D706, F-846): amir.count_vouchers' due_sql counts only the vouchers Amir can see -- the orthotic batches (stage A) and the batches of a released stage-C lot (stock_stage_event C/release naming the batch); a released lot's `since` is its release, not the round's day. Nothing else in the map moves. S533 (11/12-Oct-2026, D706 / D712; F-839, F-863): Amir's page rebuilt -- amir.bills_answer, amir.own_correction and amir.salt_list carry amir_day.DUTY_SQL byte-equal (the code runs the same strings): a bill's since-when is its first sight (purchase_bill.first_seen_day), answers are append-only (amir_bill_answer), the own-correction duty is the open wait records, the salt list is judged by one rule (the newest VERIFIED list by received_at); amir.arrival_bill_entry is retired and never due (D712: the arrival tap is reception's record; Amir's card counts the scans, amir.scan_files' marker); amir.marg_jobs counts a reopened job as due again (reopened_at). S537 (12-Oct-2026, the owner's word of 07:02 IST): amir.count_vouchers honours the void -- a batch with a stock_voucher_void row is never due (the table is laid before this map is pulled). S593 (19-Oct-2026, D743; F-739): reception.medicine_orders' due_sql gains the darpan arm -- on order.source = darpan the suppliers Darpan made pakka today (order_proposal status darpan_ok, DISTINCT supplier_norm), the same set reception's heading counts (charter 13: the door and the line read one rule). No duty added, moved or removed.

duties.duty: Answer every purchase bill of the bill-wise export (Theek hai, or what was wrong) -- S533: a bill's since-when is its first sight (first_seen_day); answers are append-only (amir_bill_answer)
duties.duty_hi: Har purchase bill par jawab -- Theek hai ya kya galat
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(first_seen_day) AS since FROM (SELECT b.id, b.first_seen_day FROM purchase_bill b JOIN purchase_export e ON e.md5 = b.bw_md5 WHERE e.type = 'BILLWISE' AND e.superseded_by IS NULL AND b.bill_date >= '2026-09-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amir_bill_answer a WHERE a.bill_id = b.id OR (a.bill_id IS NULL AND a.supplier_norm = b.supplier_norm AND a.bill_no = b.bill_no AND a.bill_date = b.bill_date)))
duties.owner_line: Amir's purchase bills unanswered: {n} -- oldest seen {since} ({days} days)

duties.duty: His own Marg correction ('Meri entry galat thi') until Marg's next bill-wise export carries the paper's amount -- S533: the open wait records, not the reason column
duties.duty_hi: Meri entry galat thi -- Marg ki agli export ka intezaar
duties.door_marker: Marg ki agli export ka intezaar
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(substr(replace(marked_at,'T',' '),1,19)) AS since FROM amir_self_wait WHERE cleared_at IS NULL
duties.owner_line: Amir's own correction not yet seen in Marg: {n} bill(s) -- since {since} ({days} days)

duties.duty: Export Marg's SALT WISE ITEM LIST (text or Excel) after salt corrections, so the server can prove them
duties.duty_hi: Ek export aur: SALT WISE ITEM LIST -- Text ya Excel, dono chalte hain
duties.door_marker: Ek export aur: SALT WISE ITEM LIST
duties.due_sql: WITH l(t) AS (SELECT MAX(substr(replace(received_at,'T',' '),1,19)) FROM mi_file WHERE type='SALT_WISE_ITEM_LIST' AND verdict='VERIFIED') SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(substr(replace(s.done_at,'T',' '),1,19)) AS since FROM purchase_salt_task s, l WHERE COALESCE(s.done,0) = 1 AND s.done_at IS NOT NULL AND s.done_at <> '' AND (l.t IS NULL OR substr(replace(s.done_at,'T',' '),1,19) > l.t)
duties.owner_line: Salt list not received for {days} days -- {n} salt corrections unproven (Amir; Shavez if it did not come)

duties.duty: Enter the stock count's Marg vouchers BY STAGE (S446, D649): A the orthotic vouchers -> verified on the next closing stock -> B the orthotic renames -> verified -> C the medicine vouchers, 12 a visit and more on request ('Aur voucher kholiye', S452) -- door added S444, staged S446 -- S524 (F-846): the due count is the orthotic batches and the released lots only -- S537: a voided batch is never due
duties.duty_hi: Stock voucher Marg mein daaliye, phir 'entered' lagaiye
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_voucher_line x WHERE x.count_id=b.count_id AND x.round_no=b.round_no AND x.kind=b.kind AND x.batch_no=b.batch_no AND x.section='Orthotics') THEN b.made_at ELSE MAX(b.made_at, (SELECT MIN(s.at) FROM stock_stage_event s WHERE s.count_id=b.count_id AND s.stage='C' AND s.event='release' AND (','||COALESCE(s.ref,'')||',') LIKE '%,'||b.round_no||'|'||b.kind||'|'||b.batch_no||',%')) END) AS since FROM (SELECT l.count_id, l.round_no, l.kind, l.batch_no, MIN(l.made_at) AS made_at FROM stock_voucher_line l GROUP BY l.count_id, l.round_no, l.kind, l.batch_no) b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_voucher_void v WHERE v.count_id=b.count_id AND v.round_no=b.round_no AND v.kind=b.kind AND v.batch_no=b.batch_no) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_voucher_entered e WHERE e.count_id = b.count_id AND e.round_no = b.round_no AND e.kind = b.kind AND e.batch_no = b.batch_no AND TRIM(COALESCE(e.marg_voucher_no,'')) <> '' AND e.id = (SELECT MAX(e2.id) FROM stock_voucher_entered e2 WHERE e2.count_id = b.count_id AND e2.round_no = b.round_no AND e2.kind = b.kind AND e2.batch_no = b.batch_no)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_voucher_line x WHERE x.count_id=b.count_id AND x.round_no=b.round_no AND x.kind=b.kind AND x.batch_no=b.batch_no AND x.section='Orthotics') OR (SELECT MIN(s.at) FROM stock_stage_event s WHERE s.count_id=b.count_id AND s.stage='C' AND s.event='release' AND (','||COALESCE(s.ref,'')||',') LIKE '%,'||b.round_no||'|'||b.kind||'|'||b.batch_no||',%') IS NOT NULL)
duties.owner_line: Count vouchers waiting: {n} -- oldest {days} days (Amir)

duties.duty: Put a selling rate in Marg's item master for each orthotic short line the close-by-rule run could not price (the board's '(b) Rate daalo', S436) -- door added S452 (his card, every step)
duties.duty_hi: Marg ke item master mein selling rate daaliye
duties.door_marker: item ka rate Marg mein daalna hai
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(r.at) AS since FROM stock_writeoff_run r, json_each(r.groups, '$.ortho_loss') j WHERE r.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM stock_writeoff_run WHERE kind = 'ortho_close') AND json_extract(j.value, '$.mrp_p') IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_rate s WHERE s.item = json_extract(j.value, '$.item') AND COALESCE(s.rate_p, 0) > 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_rate_marg m WHERE m.item = json_extract(j.value, '$.item') AND (CAST(COALESCE(m.s_rate, '0') AS REAL) > 0 OR CAST(COALESCE(m.mrp, '0') AS REAL) > 0))
duties.owner_line: Orthotic selling rates not in Marg: {n} item(s) -- since {since} ({days} days, Amir)

duties.owner_line: Full count due since {since} -- no Sunday picked ({days} days, Amir)

duties.duty: Key the bill in Marg for goods tapped as arrived on Purchase orders -- door added S446 (his card, every step) -- RETIRED S533 (D712)
duties.duty_hi: Maal aa gaya -- bill Marg mein daaliye
duties.due_sql: SELECT 0 AS n, NULL AS since
duties.coded: D712 (S533): retired from Amir's card -- the arrival tap is reception's record; an arrival with nothing scanned after arrival.bill_grace_days is the owner's line in amir_day.needs_you_lines

duties.duty: One-time Marg jobs the owner sets for him (D686): an item's category, a vendor's bill to scan for its bank details, a payment entry -- each a line on his Marg sudhar card until done -- S533: a job Marg's category list brings back is due again (reopened_at; what he said is kept)

duties.owner_line: Amir's one-time Marg jobs not done: {n} -- since {since} ({days} days)

duties.duty: Each morning: type yesterday's cash handed over and to whom
duties.duty_hi: Kal ka cash -- kitna diya, kisko diya
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(e.business_date) AS since FROM day_entry e WHERE e.unit = 'medical' AND e.business_date >= COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'darpan_kal.log_from'), '2026-09-01') AND e.business_date <= date('now','localtime','-1 day') AND e.status <> 'closed_holiday' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cash_handover_cover c WHERE c.unit = e.unit AND c.covers_date = e.business_date) AND NOT (e.status IN ('approved','locked') AND e.business_date >= COALESCE((SELECT MAX(anchor_date) FROM cash_anchor WHERE unit = 'medical'), '9999-12-31')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM darpan_kal_day k WHERE k.unit = e.unit AND k.business_date = e.business_date AND k.handed_p IS NOT NULL)

duties.duty: Vaapsi Desk 'jaankari': count the shelf for each flagged return (deterrent spot check)
duties.duty_hi: Jaankari chahiye -- shelf gin kar batayein
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(substr(s.requested_at,1,10)) AS since FROM stock_spot_check s WHERE s.status = 'due' AND s.unit = 'medical' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jaankari_answer a WHERE a.kind = 'spot' AND a.ref = CAST(s.id AS TEXT))
duties.owner_line: Return shelf checks unanswered: {n} -- oldest {since} (Vaapsi Desk)

duties.duty: Vaapsi Desk 'jaankari': settle a bill whose name and clinic ID disagree
duties.duty_hi: Jaankari chahiye -- bill ka naam / ID sahi kijiye
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(d.business_date) AS since FROM identity_dispute d WHERE d.status = 'open' AND d.unit = 'medical' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jaankari_answer a WHERE a.kind = 'dispute' AND a.ref = CAST(d.id AS TEXT))
duties.owner_line: Name / ID disputes unanswered: {n} -- oldest {since} (Vaapsi Desk)

duties.duty: After making the order in Marg, save the report PENDING ORDERS (PURCHASE) as TEXT, the default way (S454, D666) -- due only when the newest file was refused and the medical PC's reader did not stop on it (S556: that one is the owner's line, not his to redo) (save it again)
duties.duty_hi: Order sheet TEXT mein save kijiye
duties.due_sql: WITH r(t, reason) AS (SELECT substr(replace(received_at,'T',' '),1,19), COALESCE(reason,'') FROM mi_file WHERE verdict <> 'VERIFIED' AND (type = 'ORDER_PENDING' OR reason LIKE '%ORDER_PENDING%' OR reason LIKE '%PENDING ORDERS%') ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.t > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(substr(replace(received_at,'T',' '),1,19)) FROM mi_file WHERE type = 'ORDER_PENDING' AND verdict = 'VERIFIED'), '') AND NOT (reason GLOB 'the medical PC refused it: the reader refused it (line [0-9]*)' AND reason NOT GLOB '*(line *[^0-9]*)')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS n, (SELECT t FROM r) AS since
duties.owner_line: Darpan's order sheet refused -- since {since}

duties.duty: Each order day from the list time (order.darpan_list_time, 09:30): look at the system's order list on his own page -- hold a line, add a medicine, change a quantity -- and tap Pakka per supplier; reception orders what he confirmed (S485, D677; only while order.source = darpan)
duties.duty_hi: आज का ऑर्डर देखना और पक्का करना
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_norm) AS n, MIN(day) AS since FROM order_proposal WHERE day = date('now','localtime') AND status = 'open' AND COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'order.source'), 'marg_sheet') = 'darpan' AND strftime('%H:%M','now','localtime') >= COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'order.darpan_list_time'), '09:30')
duties.owner_line: Today's order list is not confirmed by Darpan: {n} supplier(s) still open since {since}
duties.coded: order_rules.needs_you_lines (S485: on order.source = darpan an order not sent rides to its next order day and raises 'Order not sent', as on system)

duties.duty: Each morning before sales: export yesterday's bill-wise sale report from Marg
duties.duty_hi: Kal ki bikri report nikaliye (counter khulne se pehle)
duties.door_marker: ki bikri report aur closing stock nikaliye
duties.due_sql: WITH RECURSIVE last(d) AS (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM sale_bill WHERE unit = 'medical'), days(d) AS (SELECT date((SELECT d FROM last),'+1 day') WHERE (SELECT d FROM last) IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT date(d,'+1 day') FROM days WHERE d < date('now','localtime','-1 day')), stop(t) AS (SELECT MAX(substr(replace(received_at,'T',' '),1,19)) FROM mi_file WHERE type = 'SALE_BILLWISE' AND verdict <> 'VERIFIED' AND substr(received_at,1,10) = date('now','localtime') AND reason GLOB 'the medical PC refused it: the reader refused it (line [0-9]*)' AND reason NOT GLOB '*(line *[^0-9]*)'), held(h) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT t FROM stop) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mi_file WHERE type = 'SALE_BILLWISE' AND verdict = 'VERIFIED' AND substr(replace(received_at,'T',' '),1,19) > (SELECT t FROM stop)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(d) AS since FROM days WHERE d <= date('now','localtime','-1 day') AND strftime('%w', d) <> '0' AND NOT ((SELECT h FROM held) = 1 AND d = (SELECT MAX(d) FROM days WHERE strftime('%w', d) <> '0'))
duties.owner_line: Sale report missing for {n} counter day(s) since {since} (Shavez)

duties.duty: Each morning before sales: export yesterday's closing stock from Marg
duties.duty_hi: Kal ka closing stock nikaliye
duties.door_marker: ki bikri report aur closing stock nikaliye
duties.due_sql: WITH RECURSIVE last(d) AS (SELECT MAX(d) FROM (SELECT substr(date_from,1,10) AS d FROM mi_file WHERE type = 'STOCK_CLOSING' AND verdict = 'VERIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT substr(as_on,7,4)||'-'||substr(as_on,4,2)||'-'||substr(as_on,1,2) FROM stock_feed WHERE source LIKE 'push_snapshot%')), days(d) AS (SELECT date((SELECT d FROM last),'+1 day') WHERE (SELECT d FROM last) IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT date(d,'+1 day') FROM days WHERE d < date('now','localtime','-1 day')), stop(t) AS (SELECT MAX(substr(replace(received_at,'T',' '),1,19)) FROM mi_file WHERE type = 'STOCK_CLOSING' AND verdict <> 'VERIFIED' AND substr(received_at,1,10) = date('now','localtime') AND reason GLOB 'the medical PC refused it: the reader refused it (line [0-9]*)' AND reason NOT GLOB '*(line *[^0-9]*)'), held(h) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT t FROM stop) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mi_file WHERE type = 'STOCK_CLOSING' AND verdict = 'VERIFIED' AND substr(replace(received_at,'T',' '),1,19) > (SELECT t FROM stop)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(d) AS since FROM days WHERE d <= date('now','localtime','-1 day') AND strftime('%w', d) <> '0' AND NOT ((SELECT h FROM held) = 1 AND d = (SELECT MAX(d) FROM days WHERE strftime('%w', d) <> '0'))
duties.owner_line: Closing stock missing for {n} counter day(s) since {since} (Shavez)

duties.duty: 1st-7th of a month: export Stock valuation and Stock expiry as on the last day of the month before
duties.duty_hi: Mahine ki do report: Stock valuation aur Stock expiry
duties.due_sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mi_file WHERE type = 'STOCK_VALUATION' AND verdict = 'VERIFIED' AND substr(received_at,1,10) >= date('now','localtime','start of month') AND substr(date_from,1,10) >= date('now','localtime','start of month','-1 day')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mi_file WHERE type = 'STOCK_EXPIRY' AND verdict = 'VERIFIED' AND substr(received_at,1,10) >= date('now','localtime','start of month') AND substr(date_from,1,10) >= date('now','localtime','start of month','-1 day')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS n, date('now','localtime','start of month') AS since
duties.owner_line: Month-end stock reports missing: {n} of 2 (valuation / expiry) -- due since {since} (Shavez)

duties.owner_line: Bill chain: Marg bill numbers missing on {n} day(s) since {since} -- the sale report of those days must be re-exported (Shavez)

duties.owner_line: Counter sheet not filled for {n} clinic day(s) -- since {since} (reception)

duties.duty: Each morning: Morning match first pass for yesterday (explain each flag)
duties.duty_hi: Morning match -- kal ka pehla pass
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(r.business_date) AS since FROM (SELECT business_date FROM clinic_day_revenue WHERE business_date >= '2026-09-13' AND business_date <= date('now','localtime','-1 day')) r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_money_day m WHERE m.business_date = r.business_date AND m.status IN ('maker_done','closed'))
duties.owner_line: Morning match not made for {n} clinic day(s) since {since} (reception / Shavez)

duties.duty: Explain each open Morning-match flag (they stay until reconciled)
duties.duty_hi: Morning match ke flag -- wajah likhiye
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(business_date) AS since FROM clinic_money_flag WHERE owner = 0 AND status = 'open'
duties.owner_line: Morning-match flags not explained: {n} -- oldest {since} (reception)

duties.duty: Check karein: a blood test written with no lab report after 2 days -- ask the lab or mark not tested
duties.duty_hi: Blood test likha tha, report nahi aayi -- lab se mangwaiye
duties.door_marker: Blood test likha tha, report nahi aayi
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(o.day) AS since FROM blood_order o WHERE o.state = 'ok' AND o.day >= '2026-09-19' AND o.day <= date('now','localtime','-2 days') AND COALESCE(o.outcome,'') = '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lab_report r WHERE r.clinic_id = o.clinic_id AND r.received_at >= o.day AND r.received_at <= date(o.day,'+7 days') || ' 23:59:59') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_check c WHERE c.key = 'bo:' || o.day || ':' || o.clinic_id AND NOT (c.answer = 'asked' AND julianday(date('now','localtime')) - julianday(substr(c.answered_at,1,10)) >= 3))
duties.owner_line: Blood reports missing, not chased: {n} -- oldest {since} (reception)

duties.duty: Check karein: an X-ray picture the mailbox could not place -- give its clinic ID or mark not an X-ray
duties.duty_hi: X-ray file ka clinic ID nahi mila -- sahi ID lagaiye
duties.door_marker: X-ray file ka clinic ID nahi mila
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(COALESCE(x.day, date('now','localtime'))) AS since FROM xray_filing x WHERE x.state = 'check' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_check c WHERE c.key = 'xf:' || x.src_id AND c.answer IN ('not_xray','id_fixed'))
duties.owner_line: X-ray files waiting for a clinic ID: {n} -- oldest {since} (reception)

duties.duty: Report baaki (X-ray): put the X-ray photo of each X-ray slip in the folder by next noon
duties.duty_hi: X-ray photo baaki -- folder mein daaliye
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(day) AS since FROM (SELECT DISTINCT s.day AS day, s.clinic_id AS cid FROM slip s JOIN slip_item i ON i.slip_id = s.id AND i.kind = 'xray' WHERE s.series = 'xp' AND s.state = 'ok' AND s.clinic_id <> '' AND s.day >= '2026-09-23' AND s.day < date('now','localtime') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_file f WHERE f.kind = 'xray' AND f.state = 'ok' AND f.clinic_id = s.clinic_id AND f.day = s.day) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pend_mark m WHERE m.key = 'xm:' || s.day || ':' || s.clinic_id AND m.act = 'not_done') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record_check c WHERE c.key = 'xm:' || s.day || ':' || s.clinic_id AND c.answer = 'not_done'))
duties.owner_line: X-ray photos not filed: {n} -- oldest {since} (reception)

duties.duty: Scan the paper of each bill still to scan: goods received with no bill scan, and Marg bills of a counted month with no scan (S454: purchase.register_from; earlier months behind 'Purana kaam', optional)
duties.duty_hi: Bill scan karna hai
duties.due_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order o WHERE o.status = 'received' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_scan_tie t WHERE t.order_id = o.id) AND substr(o.received_at,1,7) >= substr(COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'purchase.register_from'), '2026-10-01'),1,7) AND date(substr(o.received_at,1,10)) > date('now','localtime','-' || COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'purchase.arrival_scan_days'), '7') || ' days') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_bill b WHERE b.supplier_norm = COALESCE(o.supplier_norm, o.vendor) AND b.bill_date >= substr(o.created_at,1,10) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_scan_link k WHERE k.bill_id = b.id))) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_bill b WHERE b.month >= substr(COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'purchase.register_from'), '2026-10-01'),1,7) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_export e WHERE e.superseded_by IS NULL AND (e.md5 = b.bw_md5 OR e.md5 = b.sw_md5)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_scan_link k WHERE k.bill_id = b.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s454_paper_missing m WHERE m.bill_id = b.id) AND COALESCE(b.verdict,'') <> 'WRONG' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_scan_state s WHERE s.likely_bill = b.id AND s.why IN ('number_differs','amount_differs','no_digits'))) AS n, (SELECT MIN(b.bill_date) FROM purchase_bill b WHERE b.month >= substr(COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'purchase.register_from'), '2026-10-01'),1,7) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_scan_link k WHERE k.bill_id = b.id)) AS since
duties.owner_line: Bill scan waiting: {n} -- oldest {since} (after purchase.scan_wait_days)
duties.coded: porders.needs_you_lines -> scan_register.owner_lines (S454 7.3: only once the oldest is older than purchase.scan_wait_days)

duties.duty: Answer the question about a scan, one at a time ('Photo dekh kar bataiye': is this the bill? the amount on the paper; whose bill; is it a pharmacy bill?) -- counted months
duties.duty_hi: Photo dekh kar bataiye
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(substr(s.checked_at,1,10)) AS since FROM purchase_scan_state s JOIN purchase_bill b ON b.id = s.likely_bill WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_scan_link k WHERE k.asset_bill_id = s.asset_bill_id) AND s.why IN ('number_differs','amount_differs','no_digits') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s454_scan_answer a WHERE a.asset_bill_id = s.asset_bill_id AND a.kind = 'pharmacy') AND COALESCE(b.month, substr(b.bill_date,1,7)) >= substr(COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'purchase.register_from'), '2026-10-01'),1,7)
duties.owner_line: Scan questions unanswered: {n} -- oldest {since} (reception)

duties.duty: When goods come, scan the supplier's bill ('Naya bill scan karo' / 'Bill scan karo') -- the scan records the delivery by itself (S454, D668); 'Bill nahi hai, ya kam aaya?' only when something came short
duties.duty_hi: Maal aaya? -- bill scan karo
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(substr(o.created_at,1,10)) AS since FROM purchase_order o WHERE o.status = 'sent' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_scan_tie t WHERE t.order_id = o.id) AND NOT (COALESCE(o.ext_ref,'') <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.order_sheet_line x JOIN main.purchase_order_line pl ON pl.order_id = o.id AND pl.item = x.item WHERE x.last_sheet = (SELECT id FROM order_sheet ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(stamp,''),'0') DESC, taken_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) AND x.supplier_norm = o.supplier_norm AND instr(',' || o.ext_ref || ',', ',' || x.entry_no || ',') > 0))
duties.owner_line: Orders made, goods not recorded: {n} -- oldest {since}

duties.duty: Order from Darpan's order sheet (on order.source = system the day's open proposals; on darpan the suppliers Darpan made pakka -- S593): 'Sab ko WhatsApp bhejo', or call and tap 'Order ho gaya' -- S454 (D666): one card per supplier still to be ordered
duties.duty_hi: Order karna hai
duties.due_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'order.freeze'), '') <> '' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'order.source'), 'marg_sheet') = 'system' THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.supplier_norm) FROM order_proposal p WHERE p.day = date('now','localtime') AND p.status = 'open') WHEN COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'order.source'), 'marg_sheet') = 'darpan' THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.supplier_norm) FROM order_proposal p WHERE p.day = date('now','localtime') AND p.status = 'darpan_ok') ELSE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.supplier_norm) FROM order_sheet_line l WHERE l.state = 'to_order' AND l.last_sheet = (SELECT id FROM order_sheet ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(stamp,''),'0') DESC, taken_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s454_line_edit e WHERE e.src = 'sheet' AND e.ref = CAST(l.id AS TEXT) AND e.item = l.item AND e.removed = 1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_order o WHERE o.status = 'draft' AND o.order_src = 's454' AND o.supplier_norm = l.supplier_norm)) END AS n, (SELECT MIN(COALESCE(l.reorder_day, l.line_date)) FROM order_sheet_line l WHERE l.state = 'to_order' AND l.last_sheet = (SELECT id FROM order_sheet ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(stamp,''),'0') DESC, taken_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s454_line_edit e WHERE e.src = 'sheet' AND e.ref = CAST(l.id AS TEXT) AND e.item = l.item AND e.removed = 1)) AS since
duties.owner_line: Suppliers still to be ordered: {n} -- since {since}
duties.coded: order_sheet.owner_lines (an order of the sheet never placed; a supplier with no number)

duties.duty: Check each pharmacy day not yet approved against Darpan's paper and the Marg sheet ('Sahi hai' / 'Galti hai')
duties.duty_hi: Sanjeevni ke din -- jaanch: Sahi hai / Galti hai
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(e.business_date) AS since FROM day_entry e WHERE e.unit = 'medical' AND e.status IN ('submitted','draft') AND e.business_date >= COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setting WHERE key = 'darpan_kal.log_from'), '2026-08-17') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sale_check_day c WHERE c.unit = e.unit AND c.business_date = e.business_date)
duties.owner_line: Bhati has not checked {n} pharmacy day(s) -- since {since}

duties.duty: Say whether he comes today ('Aaj aayenge?') -- reception reads it
duties.duty_hi: Aaj aayenge? -- haan / nahi
duties.due_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(MAX(day),'') < date('now','localtime') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS n, CASE WHEN COALESCE(MAX(day),'') < date('now','localtime') THEN date(MAX(day),'+1 day') END AS since FROM petty_available
duties.owner_line: Bhati has not said if he is coming for {days} days (last answer before {since})

duties.duty: Tick 'Theek hai' on each physiotherapy day's figures reception wrote (last 14 days)
duties.duty_hi: Physiotherapy ka hisaab -- Theek hai
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(p.business_date) AS since FROM clinic_physio_day p WHERE p.business_date >= date('now','localtime','-14 days') AND (p.cash_p > 0 OR p.upi_p > 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM petty_physio_check c WHERE c.business_date = p.business_date)
duties.owner_line: Physiotherapy days not ticked by Bhati: {n} -- since {since}

duties.duty: Report baaki (Blood): mail each blood report the lab has not sent, tap 'Mail kar diya'
duties.duty_hi: Blood report baaki -- lab se mail karaiye
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(o.day) AS since FROM blood_order o WHERE o.state = 'ok' AND o.day >= date('now','localtime','-14 days') AND o.day < date('now','localtime') AND COALESCE(o.outcome,'') <> 'not_tested' AND COALESCE(o.later_until,'') <= date('now','localtime') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lab_report r WHERE r.clinic_id = o.clinic_id AND r.received_at >= o.day AND r.received_at <= date(o.day,'+7 days') || ' 23:59:59')
duties.owner_line: Blood reports not mailed by the lab: {n} -- oldest {since} (Sukhveer)

duties.duty: Approve each pharmacy day
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) approve the day
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(business_date) AS since FROM day_entry WHERE unit = 'medical' AND status IN ('submitted','draft')
duties.owner_line: {n} day(s) to approve (since {since})

duties.duty: OK the counter returns that wait for him
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) returns to OK
duties.due_sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CAST(substr(value, 1, instr(value, '|') - 1) AS INTEGER) FROM setting WHERE key = 'returns.pending_ok'), 0) AS n, (SELECT NULLIF(substr(value, instr(value, '|') + 1), '') FROM setting WHERE key = 'returns.pending_ok') AS since
duties.owner_line: Returns waiting for your OK: {n} -- oldest {since}
duties.coded: sanjeevni_approvals.needs_you (3) -- every open month since S446 (returns_kinds' rule); S454 (12): the due_sql reads that rule's own count (setting returns.pending_ok, kept by amir_day when Needs-you is built) -- returns.act_from applied

duties.duty: Settle the clinic-money flags that reach him (unexplained, disagreed, money not landed, sheet unfilled)
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) clinic money flags
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(business_date) AS since FROM clinic_money_flag WHERE status = 'to_owner' OR (owner = 1 AND status IN ('open','explained','cannot'))
duties.owner_line: Clinic money flags for you: {n} -- oldest {since}

duties.duty: Approve or refuse a discount / free / cancelled-after-billing on a slip
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) slip discount / cancel to approve
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(substr(made_at,1,10)) AS since FROM slip_adjust WHERE state = 'pending'
duties.owner_line: Slip discounts / cancellations to approve: {n} -- since {since}

duties.duty: Tap 'received' for the cash Darpan handed (Dr Manoj or Dr Bhawna)
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) cash handed to you -- mark received
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(business_date) AS since FROM darpan_kal_day WHERE handed_p IS NOT NULL AND received_at IS NULL
duties.owner_line: Darpan's cash not marked received: {n} day(s) -- since {since}

duties.duty: Tap 'received' on each physiotherapy day (the money paid to him or Dr Bhawna)
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) physiotherapy received
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(business_date) AS since FROM clinic_physio_day WHERE COALESCE(received_at,'') = '' AND (cash_p > 0 OR upi_p > 0)
duties.owner_line: Physiotherapy days not marked received: {n} -- since {since}

duties.duty: Confirm money given to Bhati and OK his loans in the petty book
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) petty book confirmations
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(entry_date) AS since FROM petty_entry WHERE kind IN ('receive','loan_out') AND COALESCE(void_at,'') = '' AND COALESCE(confirm_at,'') = ''
duties.owner_line: Petty book entries to confirm: {n} -- since {since}

duties.duty: Finalise last month's Marg purchases (the month the pay sheet and the NEFT are built on)
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) finalise last month's purchases
duties.due_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_month WHERE month = strftime('%Y-%m', date('now','localtime','start of month','-1 day')) AND status = 'final') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS n, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_month WHERE month = strftime('%Y-%m', date('now','localtime','start of month','-1 day')) AND status = 'final') THEN NULL ELSE date('now','localtime','start of month') END AS since
duties.owner_line: Last month's purchases not finalised -- due since {since} ({days} days)

duties.duty: Settle a bill whose paper amount matched neither the scan nor Marg
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) scan amount to settle
duties.due_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(substr(confirmed_at,1,10)) AS since FROM purchase_scan_state WHERE amount_state = 'owner'
duties.owner_line: Scan amounts to settle: {n}

duties.duty: Export Marg's SALT WISE ITEM LIST (weekly)
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) export the salt-wise list from Marg
duties.due_sql: WITH l(d) AS (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(substr(date_from,1,10),''), substr(received_at,1,10))) FROM mi_file WHERE type='SALT_WISE_ITEM_LIST' AND verdict='VERIFIED'), k(lim) AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM setting WHERE key='owner.salt_list_days' AND value <> '' AND value NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'), 8)) SELECT CASE WHEN l.d IS NULL OR julianday(date('now','localtime')) - julianday(l.d) > k.lim THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS n, CASE WHEN l.d IS NOT NULL AND julianday(date('now','localtime')) - julianday(l.d) > k.lim THEN date(l.d, '+' || (k.lim + 1) || ' days') END AS since FROM l, k
duties.owner_line: Your salt list from Marg is overdue -- due since {since}

duties.duty: Export Marg's CATEGORY WISE ITEM LIST and the item list (monthly)
duties.duty_hi: (owner, English) export the category-wise list and the item list from Marg
duties.due_sql: WITH k(lim) AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM setting WHERE key='owner.item_lists_days' AND value <> '' AND value NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'), 35)), t(typ) AS (VALUES ('CATEGORY_WISE_ITEM_LIST'), ('ITEM_MASTER')), l(typ, d) AS (SELECT t.typ, (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(substr(m.date_from,1,10),''), substr(m.received_at,1,10))) FROM mi_file m WHERE m.type = t.typ AND m.verdict = 'VERIFIED') FROM t) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.d IS NULL OR julianday(date('now','localtime')) - julianday(l.d) > k.lim THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n, MIN(CASE WHEN l.d IS NOT NULL AND julianday(date('now','localtime')) - julianday(l.d) > k.lim THEN date(l.d, '+' || (k.lim + 1) || ' days') END) AS since FROM l, k
duties.owner_line: Your monthly Marg lists are overdue: {n} of 2 (category list / item list) -- due since {since}
